string.text: The goblin-warrens of Blue Craig in the Blue Mountains (Ered Luin) of the far west, hard by the Grey Havens of Lindon. A distinct, numberless host of goblin-kind — separate from their Misty Mountains cousins of Goblin Town — they swarm the western crags and trouble the Elves of the western shore.
Dol Guldur, the fortress of shadow and despair, stands as a menacing beacon of the Necromancer's dark will. The Orcs and foul creatures that inhabit its depths strike fear into the hearts of all.

The Lonely Mountain, Erebor, stands as the greatest of the Dwarven kingdoms in the north. Rich in gold and mithril, it is home to the line of Durin. The Dwarves of Erebor are renowned craftsmen and fierce warriors, their halls echoing with the songs of their ancestors.

The Goblins of the High Pass swarm the tunnels beneath the Misty Mountains, the spawn of the host the Great Goblin once led against dwarf and wayfarer alike. Numberless and vicious, they pour from Goblin-town to raid the mountain roads.
Gundabad, the ancient and foreboding stronghold of the Orcs, stands as a bastion of savagery and domination. The Orcs of Gundabad, bred for war and chaos, rally under bloodied banners.
Isengard, the stronghold of the White Wizard Saruman, stands as a bastion of power and ambition. The Uruk-hai march forth under the banner of the White Hand, their discipline and savagery unmatched.

Lindon, the green land west of the Blue Mountains, is the last realm of the High Elves upon the shores of Middle-earth. From the Grey Havens of Mithlond the white ships sail into the West, while Círdan the Shipwright keeps watch over the fading light of the Eldar.

The Golden Wood lies nestled between the Silverlode and the mighty Anduin. Guarded by the will of Galadriel and Celeborn, it stands as a bastion of Elven grace and defiance - a land untouched by time, where the leaves do not fall.

The Woodland Realm of Mirkwood has endured much hardship over the years. Under the leadership of Thranduil, the Woodelves have become reclusive and wary of strangers. Yet in the heart of Thranduil lingers a fire kindled in the ancient days of the First Age.

The orc-host of the Misty Mountains holds the high places and deep delvings from Mount Gram to the gates of Moria. Bred for war in the cold peaks, they answer the call of the Shadow and hunger to reclaim the mountains for their own.

Hidden deep within the clefts of the Misty Mountains, Rivendell is the Last Homely House East of the Sea. Founded by Elrond Half-elven, it is a refuge against the gathering dark, a place of healing, lore, and quiet strength.
Umbar, the dark haven of the Corsairs, is a realm steeped in maritime power and treacherous ambition. The Corsairs raid the coasts of Middle-earth, spreading fear with their swift ships.
